dialogues.speaker: Aphila
dialogues.text: No, I'm waiting for my Saurian! They are my trusty partner.

dialogues.speaker: Aphila
dialogues.text: We've known each other since we were very little, and pretty much grew up together. According to the elders in the tribe, our birthdays were separated by just one day.

dialogues.speaker: Aphila
dialogues.text: They learned everything a lot faster when we were little, too. At one point, I was worried that they'd leave me behind, since they learned how to fly so much faster than me.

dialogues.speaker: Aphila
dialogues.text: All was well, though, for I soon caught up! It wasn't long before we went on our first flight together, and I decided to name them "The Twilight of That Day."

dialogues.speaker: Aphila
dialogues.text: I just love them so much, I can never shut up when I start talking about them. It's my bad.
